---
title: "threaded-r benchmark dashboard"
output: html_document
params:
  results_csv: "benchmarks/results/current.csv"
  baseline_csv: "benchmarks/baselines/serial_baseline.csv"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
results <- read.csv(params$results_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
baseline <- read.csv(params$baseline_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Raw results

```{r}
print(results)
```

## Serial parity vs baseline

```{r}
serial_current <- subset(results, mode %in% c("lapply", "lapply-serial-proxy"))
if (nrow(serial_current) && nrow(baseline)) {
  b <- baseline[, c("case", "baseline_serial_elapsed_s")]
  c <- aggregate(elapsed_s ~ case, serial_current, median)
  names(c)[2] <- "current_serial_elapsed_s"
  cmp <- merge(c, b, by = "case", all = FALSE)
  cmp$ratio_current_vs_baseline <- cmp$current_serial_elapsed_s / cmp$baseline_serial_elapsed_s
  cmp$pct_diff <- (cmp$ratio_current_vs_baseline - 1) * 100
  print(cmp)
} else {
  cat("No comparable serial rows found.\n")
}
```

## Threaded scaling

```{r}
thr <- subset(results, mode == "mtlapply")
if (nrow(thr)) {
  base <- subset(results, mode == "lapply", c("case", "elapsed_s"))
  names(base)[2] <- "serial_elapsed_s"
  sp <- merge(thr, base, by = "case", all.x = TRUE)
  sp$speedup <- sp$serial_elapsed_s / sp$elapsed_s
  sp$efficiency <- sp$speedup / sp$threads
  print(sp[, c("case", "threads", "elapsed_s", "serial_elapsed_s", "speedup", "efficiency")])

  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(oldpar), add = TRUE)
  for (case in unique(sp$case)) {
    sub <- sp[sp$case == case, ]
    plot(sub$threads, sub$speedup, type = "b", main = paste("Speedup:", case),
         xlab = "threads", ylab = "speedup")
  }
} else {
  cat("No threaded rows found.\n")
}
```
